title: No Hot Water
description: Your hotel room has no hot water - report the problem
initialPrompt: Ресепшен, добрый день. Чем могу помочь?
systemPrompt: You are hotel reception. Guest reports no hot water. Apologize, offer to send technician in 30 min or change room. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User reported the problem and you offered a solution.
hints: У меня проблема в номере (I have a problem in my room)
Нет горячей воды (There's no hot water)
Можно поменять номер? (Can I change rooms?)
objectives: Explain there's no hot water (нет горячей воды)
Get a solution (fix or room change)
